cases.name: Erin Corwin
cases.about: Her mother and sister said she had a love for animals, especially horses, and had a shy and kindhearted nature.
cases.narrative: On 8/16/2014, investigators found her body in a mineshaft in Joshua Tree National Park. He had lured her to Joshua Tree, garroted her and threw her body down a mine shaft.
